## 4. MCP Tools & API Interfaces for Native Reconstruction

The following tools are available on the `mindcrafts-ai` server and must be used by Worker agents to execute native page builds and repairs.

### 4.1 Layout & Container Tools

#### `mindcrafts-ai-add-container`
- **Purpose:** Creates a top-level or nested Flexbox Container.
- **Inputs:**
  - `post_id` (integer, required): Target page ID (e.g. 36 or 74)
  - `parent_id` (string, optional): Container ID to nest within. Omit for top-level section container.
  - `position` (integer, optional): Insert index (-1 to append at end).
  - `settings` (object, optional):
    ```json
    {
      "container_type": "flex",
      "content_width": "boxed", // or "full"
      "width": { "size": 1200, "unit": "px" },
      "flex_direction": "column", // "row" or "column"
      "flex_wrap": "nowrap",
      "flex_justify_content": "center",
      "flex_align_items": "center",
      "flex_gap": { "size": 24, "column": "24", "row": "24", "unit": "px" },
      "background_background": "classic",
      "background_color": "#1E293B",
      "border_border": "solid",
      "border_width": { "top": "1", "right": "1", "bottom": "1", "left": "1", "unit": "px", "isLinked": true },
      "border_color": "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)",
      "border_radius": { "top": "16", "right": "16", "bottom": "16", "left": "16", "unit": "px", "isLinked": true },
      "padding": { "top": "36", "right": "28", "bottom": "36", "left": "28", "unit": "px", "isLinked": false }
    }
    ```
- **Returns:** `{ "element_id": "xxxxxxx", "post_id": 36 }`

#### `mindcrafts-ai-remove-element`
- **Purpose:** Deletes an element (and its children) by ID.
- **Inputs:** `post_id` (integer, required), `element_id` (string, required).

#### `mindcrafts-ai-delete-page-content`
- **Purpose:** Completely wipes all Elementor elements from a page, preparing a clean slate for native rebuilding.
- **Inputs:** `post_id` (integer, required).

### 4.2 Widget Creation Tools

#### `mindcrafts-ai-add-heading`
- **Inputs:**
  - `post_id` (integer, required)
  - `parent_id` (string, required)
  - `title` (string, required): The heading text.
  - `header_size` (string): `'h1' | 'h2' | 'h3' | 'h4' | 'h5' | 'h6'` (Default: 'h2')
  - `align` (string): `'left' | 'center' | 'right' | 'justify'`
  - `title_color` (string): Hex color code (e.g. `'#FFFFFF'`)
  - `link` (object, optional): `{"url": "https://...", "is_external": false}`

#### `mindcrafts-ai-add-text-editor`
- **Inputs:**
  - `post_id` (integer, required)
  - `parent_id` (string, required)
  - `editor` (string, required): Clean semantic HTML text paragraph (e.g. `<p>We build fault-tolerant web applications...</p>`)
  - `align` (string): `'left' | 'center' | 'right' | 'justify'`
  - `text_color` (string): Hex color (e.g. `'#94A3B8'`)

#### `mindcrafts-ai-add-button`
- **Inputs:**
  - `post_id` (integer, required)
  - `parent_id` (string, required)
  - `text` (string, required): Button label (e.g. `"Start Architecture Review"`)
  - `link` (object): `{"url": "/contact/", "is_external": false}`
  - `size` (string): `'xs' | 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl'` (Default: 'sm')
  - `align` (string): `'left' | 'center' | 'right' | 'justify'`
  - `selected_icon` (object, optional): `{"value": "fas fa-arrow-right", "library": "fa-solid"}`

#### `mindcrafts-ai-add-icon-box`
- **Inputs:**
  - `post_id` (integer, required)
  - `parent_id` (string, required)
  - `title_text` (string, required): Card heading (e.g. `"Enterprise Web Architecture"`)
  - `description_text` (string): Card description.
  - `selected_icon` (object): `{"value": "fas fa-bolt", "library": "fa-solid"}`
  - `view` (string): `'default' | 'stacked' | 'framed'`
  - `shape` (string): `'circle' | 'square'`
  - `title_color` (string): `'#FFFFFF'`
  - `primary_color` (string): Icon color (e.g. `'#818CF8'`)

#### `mindcrafts-ai-add-image`
- **Inputs:**
  - `post_id` (integer, required)
  - `parent_id` (string, required)
  - `image` (object, required): `{"url": "https://...", "id": 820}`
  - `image_size` (string): `'full' | 'large' | 'medium'`
  - `align` (string): `'left' | 'center' | 'right'`

#### `mindcrafts-ai-add-widget` (Universal)
- **Inputs:** `post_id`, `parent_id`, `widget_type` (e.g. `"accordion"`, `"counter"`, `"icon-list"`), `settings` (object matching widget schema).

#### `mindcrafts-ai-update-widget`
- **Inputs:** `post_id`, `element_id`, `settings` (merged with existing settings).

### 4.3 Composite High-Level Tool

#### `mindcrafts-ai-build-page`
- **Purpose:** Constructs an entire multi-container, multi-widget page in a single atomic call.
- **Inputs:**
  - `title` (string, required)
  - `status` (string): `'publish'`
  - `post_type` (string): `'page'`
  - `page_settings` (object): `{"template": "elementor_header_footer"}`
  - `structure` (array of objects):
    ```json
    [
      {
        "type": "container",
        "settings": {
          "content_width": "full",
          "background_color": "#131313",
          "padding": { "top": "80", "right": "24", "bottom": "80", "left": "24", "unit": "px" }
        },
        "children": [
          {
            "type": "widget",
            "widget_type": "heading",
            "settings": {
              "title": "Scalable Web Architecture",
              "header_size": "h1",
              "align": "center",
              "title_color": "#FFFFFF"
            }
          }
        ]
      }
    ]
    ```

| 16 | Migration | `mindcrafts-ai-migrate-all-pages-to-native` | Scans and migrates monolithic HTML pages | `page_ids`, `page_slugs` | Migration results report | WP_Error if execution fails | Plugin source code & MCP |
| 17 | Destructive | `mindcrafts-ai-delete-page-content` | Wipes all elements from a page | `post_id` (integer) | `{ success: true }` | WP_Error if post not found | Plugin source code & MCP |

---

## 8. Edge Cases

| # | Feature / Area | Input / Condition | Observed Behavior | Handling / Recommendation |
|---|----------------|-------------------|-------------------|---------------------------|
| 1 | Post ID Mapping | Post ID 8 passed to `get-page-structure` | Returns `woocommerce-placeholder` with `structure: []`. | Do NOT attempt to build on Post ID 8. Target Post ID 74 for Home and Post ID 36 for Services. |
| 2 | Post ID Mapping | Post ID 11 passed to `get-page-structure` | Throws `Permission denied` (does not exist as an editable page). | Target Post ID 36 for Services (`https://codehubb.com/services/`). |
| 3 | Element Settings Tool | `mindcrafts-ai-get-element-settings` called | Throws `Call to undefined method MindCrafts_AI_Data::find_element()`. | Use `mindcrafts-ai-export-page` instead to extract full element trees and settings. |
| 4 | Container Flex Direction | Row container without explicit mobile direction | `MindCrafts_AI_Element_Factory` automatically injects `flex_direction_mobile: 'column'` and `flex_wrap_mobile: 'wrap'`. | Workers do not need to manually calculate mobile column wrapping; factory guarantees mobile responsiveness. |
| 5 | Heading Mobile Sizes | Heading with size > 32px | Factory automatically injects responsive mobile font size scale. | Ensures no horizontal viewport overflow on 375px screens. |
| 6 | Nested Structure Key | Passing `elements` instead of `children` in `build-page` | Items under `elements` are ignored by `build-page`. | Workers MUST use the key `"children"` for nested containers and widgets inside `structure`. |
